Baby Bellini Aperitif

Served at: Feast of the Holy Innocents (Childermas Banquet)

Serves 4-6Prep 15 min

The Feast of the Holy Innocents, observed on December 28th, is a day of remembrance for the young children lost in Bethlehem. While a solemn occasion, a Childermas Banquet often follows, and a 'Baby Bellini' offers a light, sweet, and refreshing aperitif. This non-alcoholic version, with its gentle peach flavor and sparkling effervescence, is a delightful and inclusive way to begin the meal, honoring the spirit of innocence.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups (approx. 300g) ripe fresh peaches, peeled, pitted, and chopped OR 10 ounces (approx. 280g) frozen unsweetened peach slices, thawed
  • 1-2 tablespoons (15-30ml) simple syrup or honey, optional, to taste
  • 1 bottle (750ml) sparkling white grape juice or non-alcoholic sparkling cider, chilled
  • Fresh mint sprigs or thin peach slices, for garnish (optional)

Method

  1. If using fresh peaches, peel, pit, and chop them. If using frozen, ensure they are thawed.
  2. Place the chopped or thawed peaches into a blender.
  3. Blend until completely smooth, adding 1-2 tablespoons (15-30ml) of water if needed to achieve a pourable consistency.
  4. For a smoother aperitif, press the peach puree through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl, discarding any solids.
  5. Taste the peach puree and stir in optional simple syrup or honey if desired, to sweeten.
  6. Chill the peach puree in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes, or until well-chilled.
  7. To serve, spoon about 2-3 tablespoons (30-45ml) of the chilled peach puree into the bottom of each champagne flute or elegant glass.
  8. Slowly top with the chilled sparkling white grape juice or cider, allowing the bubbles to mix gently with the peach puree.
  9. Garnish each glass with a fresh mint sprig or a thin peach slice, if desired, and serve immediately.

Tips

  • For an adult version, substitute the sparkling grape juice with chilled Prosecco or Cava.
  • Make the peach puree ahead of time and store it in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
  • Ensure all ingredients are thoroughly chilled for the best refreshing taste.
